claims.claim: You need to give details of the child's care needs.
claims.quote: The rate the child gets depends on the level of looking after they need, for example: lowest rate - help for some of the day
claims.note: The text says the award depends on the level of looking after the child needs but does not say the claim asks for details of care needs.

claims.claim: You need to give details of the supervision the child requires.
claims.quote: middle rate - frequent help or continual supervision during the day, supervision at night or someone to help while they’re on dialysis
claims.note: Supervision is named as a factor in the care rate, but the text does not say you must provide supervision details when claiming.

claims.claim: Reports from a GP or consultant are used as evidence for the claim.
claims.quote: Ask a medical professional for form SR1.
claims.note: The text only mentions an SR1 form from a medical professional for children nearing the end of life, not GP or consultant reports for claims generally.
